items.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: She was already dead but I heard her on the record.

ctx.x: Is it safe to say you’ve been influenced more by horn players than singers?

Yeah. Much more by instruments than singers. Much more. And then I heard Billie Holiday and of course I adored her. Billie Holiday. She was already dead but I heard her on the record. And I adored her but I couldn’t relate to this thing that there was so much sadness in her, and it became a very one thing trip. You know she wouldn’t improvise much, she wouldn’t — it was all about just her voice expressing the experiences in her life. And that was too heavy for me.
